name: Filling the Soul Gem
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, you reach Yenniku while he remains caught in a trance. A prepared soul gem may preserve him by taking his spirit.

sections.title: A Trance in the Jungle
sections.body: Yenniku, the young troll you have tried to save, stands motionless before you in Stranglethorn Vale. His mind is far away. The enchanted gem prepared to hold his essence is the only path forward.

sections.title: The Vessel
sections.body: The soul gem pressed to Yenniku's forehead draws his spirit into the stone. His body shudders, then collapses as an empty, mindless shell.

faq.q: What condition is Yenniku in when you reach him?
faq.answer: When you reach Yenniku, he is stunned and unresponsive, his thoughts held far from the world around him.

faq.q: What item is used on Yenniku?
faq.answer: You use a soul gem brought from Stranglethorn Vale on Yenniku.

aliases: prereq for filling the soul gem
faq.answer: This moment follows the events of Saving Yenniku in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.
